# TeleCrypt.io Storage CLI

> End-to-end encrypted file storage and sharing on Matrix, distributed only as exact GitHub
> Release archives. The canonical command and recovery reference is [CLI.md](./CLI.md).

TeleCrypt.io Storage CLI provides the `telecrypt-io storage` command group over one exact
`@telecrypt-io/storage` library version. It supports MAS/OIDC device authorization, private local
profiles, shared vaults, nested folders, encrypted file upload/download, and server-side recovery-key
setup/export and restore. It never sends a Matrix password login and the server cannot decrypt files.

Install only an existing exact release archive, never an NPM registry package. Use the command
reference for the immutable archive URL, runtime requirement, `--json` contract, profile security,
sharing, file, logout, and recovery behavior.

For agents, treat exit code 0 as success and nonzero as failure; with `--json`, parse the structured
success output on stdout or the error object on stderr. Preserve the Recovery Key: it is required to
restore encrypted keys on a new device. Logout revokes the server session before deleting local
credentials; if revocation fails, the profile remains for retry.

The CLI is Linux-only and requires Node.js 24.20.0 or newer. Set `TELECRYPT_IO_STORAGE_HOME` only
to a canonical absolute path; `storage login --no-browser` suppresses the optional browser launch.
Profile confidentiality comes from owner-only filesystem permissions; the
profile's bearer credentials and cryptographic state do not have an additional application-level
at-rest encryption wrapper.

Development and real-stack acceptance are local-only. The Storage SDK repository owns the disposable
fixture; Harness acceptance is never hosted CI and never targets a production server.
